raw_reason: Lack of Approval from Third Party
canonical_reason: Lack of Approval from Third Party
definition_used: One or more third parties did not approve one or more parts of the research or publication process(es). RW also uses this reason if the notice mentions a lack of documentation of alleged approval.
caution: The definition is broad and could encompass various approval types (ethics, data access, institutional). Without specifics, we assign general categories; if the lack of approval pertains to ethics, research_content_reliability might also apply, but we default to the most direct categories.
semantic_rationale: Lack of third-party approval directly implicates disclosure and governance processes, as it involves missing permissions that affect authorship/attribution integrity and editorial oversight of required approvals.
